integrity: Exact finite-degree norm identities and extremizers are analytic; numerical checks are supplemental, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only for endpoint evaluations on the real Euclidean Lipschitz unit ball; no all-position or finite-degree domination claim. Classical Jacobi Darboux/endpoint estimates are invoked. Earlier unindexed equivalent constants remain possible.
title: Sharp Lipschitz endpoint errors of Legendre and Chebyshev spectral projections
